example_en: Please write a clear subject line.
example_zh: 請寫一個清楚的主旨。
note: 主旨要具體，例如含日期或專案名稱

example_en: Check the recipient before you hit send.
example_zh: 按下傳送前先確認收件人。

example_en: The sender's name looks unfamiliar.
example_zh: 這個寄件人的名字看起來很陌生。

example_en: The attachment is missing from your email.
example_zh: 你的信裡漏了附件。

example_en: My inbox is full after the holiday.
example_zh: 放完假後我的收件匣爆滿。

example_en: Please cc my manager on this email.
example_zh: 這封信請副本給我的主管。
note: carbon copy 的縮寫

example_en: I'll bcc all customers to protect their privacy.
example_zh: 我會用密件副本寄給所有客戶以保護隱私。
note: blind carbon copy，其他收件人看不到

example_en: Please don't reply all to this message.
example_zh: 這封信請不要按全部回覆。

example_en: Could you forward me the customer's email?
example_zh: 可以把客戶那封信轉寄給我嗎？

example_en: See the email thread below for background.
example_zh: 背景請見下方的郵件串。

example_en: Please add your phone number to your email signature.
example_zh: 請在郵件簽名檔加上你的電話。

example_en: I saved the reply as a draft.
example_zh: 我把回信存成草稿了。

example_en: Your email went to my spam folder.
example_zh: 你的信跑到我的垃圾郵件匣了。

example_en: Please add me to the project distribution list.
example_zh: 請把我加進專案的群組收件名單。

example_en: I requested a read receipt for the contract email.
example_zh: 合約那封信我有要求讀取回條。

example_en: My email to the supplier bounced back.
example_zh: 我寄給供應商的信被退回了。

example_en: I got his out-of-office reply until Monday.
example_zh: 我收到他到週一前不在辦公室的自動回覆。
note: 常縮寫為 OOO

example_en: Please set an auto-reply before your trip.
example_zh: 出差前請設定自動回覆。

example_en: I'm composing a reply to the client now.
example_zh: 我正在撰寫給客戶的回信。

example_en: Use a formal salutation for new clients.
example_zh: 給新客戶的信請用正式稱呼開頭。
note: 例如 Dear Ms. Lin,

example_en: "Best regards" is a safe sign-off.
example_zh: 「Best regards」是很保險的結語。

example_en: She added a postscript about the office party.
example_zh: 她在信末附註了尾牙的事。

example_en: Send all orders to the sales shared mailbox.
example_zh: 所有訂單請寄到業務部的共用信箱。

example_en: I'll send you a calendar invite for Thursday.
example_zh: 我會寄週四的行事曆邀請給你。

example_en: Please don't mark routine emails as urgent.
example_zh: 一般例行信件請不要標示為緊急。

example_en: I flagged your email so I won't forget.
example_zh: 我把你的信加了標記，免得忘記。

example_en: I archive old emails every Friday.
example_zh: 我每週五封存舊郵件。

example_en: Click here to unsubscribe from this newsletter.
example_zh: 點這裡取消訂閱這份電子報。

example_en: Report any phishing email to IT immediately.
example_zh: 收到釣魚郵件請立刻通報資訊部。

example_en: Could you confirm your email address?
example_zh: 可以確認一下你的電子郵件地址嗎？

zh: 親愛的某某先生／女士（正式開頭）
example_en: Dear Mr. / Ms. Chen, thank you for your email.
example_zh: 陳先生／女士您好，感謝您的來信。
note: Ms. 不透露婚姻狀態，比 Miss/Mrs. 安全

example_en: To whom it may concern, I am writing about an invoice.
example_zh: 敬啟者：本信是關於一張發票。
note: 不知道收件人姓名時使用，偏正式

en: I hope this email finds you well
ipa: /aɪ hoʊp ðɪs ˈiːmeɪl faɪndz juː wel/
example_en: I hope this email finds you well.
example_zh: 希望您一切安好。
note: 常見的客套開場白

example_en: I am writing to confirm our order.
example_zh: 來信是為了確認我們的訂單。

en: I am writing on behalf of
example_en: I am writing on behalf of our CEO.
example_zh: 謹代表本公司執行長來信。

example_en: Thank you for your email about the delivery.
example_zh: 感謝您來信詢問交貨事宜。

en: Thank you for getting back to me
ipa: /θæŋk juː fɔːr ˈɡetɪŋ bæk tə miː/
example_en: Thank you for getting back to me so quickly.
example_zh: 謝謝您這麼快回覆我。

example_en: Further to our call, here is the quote.
example_zh: 延續我們的通話，附上報價。
note: 英式正式用法

example_en: As per our discussion, I've updated the schedule.
example_zh: 依照我們討論的內容，我已更新時程。

example_en: With reference to your order, delivery is confirmed.
example_zh: 關於您的訂單，交貨已確認。

example_en: I'm reaching out to ask about your new plan.
example_zh: 我來信是想詢問你們的新方案。
note: 比 I am writing to 口語親切

example_en: Allow me to introduce myself as your new account manager.
example_zh: 請容我自我介紹，我是您的新客戶經理。

en: It was a pleasure meeting you
example_en: It was a pleasure meeting you in Tokyo.
example_zh: 很高興在東京與您見面。

example_en: Sorry for the late reply; I was traveling.
example_zh: 抱歉晚回覆，我剛才在出差。

example_en: Apologies for the delayed response to your inquiry.
example_zh: 抱歉延遲回覆您的詢問。
note: 比 Sorry for the late reply 更正式

example_en: Just a quick note to say the files are ready.
example_zh: 簡單跟你說一聲，檔案準備好了。

example_en: Hi team, please see the update below.
example_zh: 大家好，請看以下更新。

en: Thank you for your continued support
zh: 感謝您一直以來的支持（承蒙關照）
example_en: Thank you for your continued support.
example_zh: 感謝您一直以來的支持。
note: 接近日文「いつもお世話になっております」

en: I look forward to our continued cooperation
ipa: /aɪ lʊk ˈfɔːrwɚd tuː ˈaʊɚ kənˈtɪnjuːd koʊˌɑːpəˈreɪʃən/
example_en: I look forward to our continued cooperation.
example_zh: 期待今後持續合作。
note: 接近日文「今後ともよろしくお願いいたします」

example_en: Sorry to bother you, but I have one more question.
example_zh: 不好意思打擾，我還有一個問題。

example_en: Please find attached the revised quotation.
example_zh: 附件為修改後的報價單，請查收。

example_en: I have attached the meeting minutes.
example_zh: 我已附上會議紀錄。

example_en: The enclosed form must be signed.
example_zh: 隨信附上的表格需要簽名。
note: 原指紙本信件同封，email 也常用

example_en: I've attached last year's report for your reference.
example_zh: 附上去年的報告供您參考。
note: 縮寫 FYR

example_en: The draft contract is attached for your review.
example_zh: 附上合約草稿，請您審閱。

example_en: Here is a copy of the receipt for your records.
example_zh: 這是收據副本，供您存檔。

example_en: Please see below for the customer's request.
example_zh: 客戶的需求請見下方。

example_en: Please see the link below to download the slides.
example_zh: 請由下方連結下載簡報。

example_en: Could you resend the file? I can't open it.
example_zh: 可以重寄那個檔案嗎？我打不開。

example_en: The video exceeds the file size limit.
example_zh: 這個影片超過檔案大小上限。

example_en: The file is password-protected; I'll send the password separately.
example_zh: 檔案有密碼保護，密碼我另外寄。
note: 日商常見做法：附件加密、密碼另寄

example_en: I've uploaded the photos to the shared folder.
example_zh: 照片我已經上傳到共用資料夾。

example_en: Could you grant me access permission to the folder?
example_zh: 可以給我那個資料夾的存取權限嗎？

example_en: Could you please check the figures again?
example_zh: 可以麻煩您再核對一次數字嗎？

example_en: Would you mind sending it again?
example_zh: 您介意再寄一次嗎？
note: 後面接動名詞 -ing

example_en: I would appreciate it if you could reply by Friday.
example_zh: 若您能在週五前回覆，將不勝感激。

example_en: I'd be grateful if you could share the data.
example_zh: 如果您能提供資料，我會很感激。

example_en: Please let me know if Monday works.
example_zh: 週一可不可以請告訴我。

example_en: Please reply at your earliest convenience.
example_zh: 請您方便時儘早回覆。
note: 客氣但仍有催促意味

example_en: Which option do you prefer? Please advise.
example_zh: 您偏好哪個方案？請告知。

example_en: Kindly confirm receipt of this email.
example_zh: 敬請確認收到此信。
note: 語氣正式，用太多會顯得生硬

example_en: Please feel free to call me anytime.
example_zh: 請隨時打電話給我。

example_en: I was wondering if you could join the call.
example_zh: 不知道您能否參加這通會議。
note: 委婉提出請求

example_en: Would it be possible to extend the deadline?
example_zh: 截止日是否有可能延後？

example_en: Please fill out the attached form.
example_zh: 請填寫附件的表格。

example_en: Please sign and return the NDA by Friday.
example_zh: 請在週五前把保密協議簽名後寄回。

example_en: Please acknowledge receipt of this notice.
example_zh: 請確認收到本通知。

example_en: Could you share the latest traffic report?
example_zh: 可以提供最新的流量報告嗎？

example_en: Please review and approve the budget by Wednesday.
example_zh: 請在週三前審核並核准預算。

example_en: We kindly ask that you pay within 30 days.
example_zh: 懇請您於三十天內付款。

example_en: I'm following up on my email from last week.
example_zh: 我想跟進上週寄的那封信。

example_en: I'll send a follow-up after the meeting.
example_zh: 會後我會寄一封後續信件。

example_en: Just a gentle reminder about tomorrow's deadline.
example_zh: 溫馨提醒一下明天的截止日。
note: 催人時的客氣說法

example_en: Just checking in on the status of the order.
example_zh: 想確認一下訂單的進度。

example_en: Any update on the repair schedule?
example_zh: 維修時程有任何進展嗎？

example_en: I haven't heard back from the vendor yet.
example_zh: 我還沒收到廠商的回音。

example_en: Let's circle back on pricing next week.
example_zh: 價格的部分我們下週再回頭討論。

example_en: Could you chase the supplier for the invoice?
example_zh: 可以幫忙向供應商催一下發票嗎？
note: 英式用法常見

example_en: There are still two outstanding issues.
example_zh: 還有兩個問題尚未處理。
note: 另有「傑出的」意思，看上下文

example_en: We are awaiting your reply on the proposal.
example_zh: 我們正在等候您對提案的回覆。

example_en: Let's touch base on Friday afternoon.
example_zh: 我們週五下午簡單聯繫一下。

example_en: Please keep me posted on the test results.
example_zh: 測試結果有消息請隨時通知我。

example_en: Please keep me in the loop on this issue.
example_zh: 這件事請讓我掌握最新狀況。

example_en: I'm looping in Ken from the legal team.
example_zh: 我把法務部的 Ken 加進來。

example_en: As a reminder, the office is closed on Monday.
example_zh: 提醒一下，週一辦公室休息。

example_en: This is a second reminder about the unpaid invoice.
example_zh: 這是關於未付發票的第二次提醒。

example_en: Are you available for a call tomorrow?
example_zh: 您明天有空通個電話嗎？

example_en: Does 3 p.m. Tuesday work for you?
example_zh: 週二下午三點您方便嗎？

example_en: Thursday morning? That works for me.
example_zh: 週四上午嗎？我可以。

example_en: Could you propose a time that suits you?
example_zh: 可以提議一個您方便的時間嗎？

example_en: Can we reschedule the call to next week?
example_zh: 這通會議可以改到下週嗎？

example_en: Please pick a time slot from the list.
example_zh: 請從清單中選一個時段。

example_en: The meeting is at 10 a.m. Tokyo time zone.
example_zh: 會議是東京時區上午十點。
note: 台灣 UTC+8，日本 UTC+9

example_en: The date is tentative until the client confirms.
example_zh: 客戶確認前，這個日期是暫定的。

example_en: I have a scheduling conflict on Monday.
example_zh: 我週一有行程衝突。

example_en: Sorry, I'm double-booked at that time.
example_zh: 抱歉，我那個時段已經撞期了。

example_en: Can we push back the meeting by an hour?
example_zh: 會議可以往後延一小時嗎？
note: 另有「反對」之意

example_en: We need to bring forward the launch date.
example_zh: 我們需要把上市日期提前。

example_en: Noted, thank you for the update.
example_zh: 了解，謝謝更新。
note: 簡短回覆，對長官可加 with thanks

example_en: Your documents are well received.
example_zh: 您的文件已收到。
note: 亞洲商務常見，母語者多說 I've received

example_en: Understood. I'll fix it today.
example_zh: 明白了，我今天會修正。

example_en: Just to confirm, the deadline is the 15th?
example_zh: 再確認一下，截止日是 15 號嗎？

zh: 說明清楚一點；澄清一下
example_en: To clarify, the price excludes tax.
example_zh: 澄清一下，這個價格不含稅。

example_en: I need some clarification on item 3.
example_zh: 第三項我需要進一步說明。

example_en: Could you elaborate on the second point?
example_zh: 第二點可以詳細說明嗎？

zh: 如果我理解有誤請指正
example_en: Correct me if I'm wrong, but the order is 500 units?
example_zh: 如果我理解有誤請指正，訂單是 500 個嗎？

example_en: As mentioned, the system will be down tonight.
example_zh: 如先前所述，系統今晚會停機。

example_en: As discussed, I've sent the draft to legal.
example_zh: 如同我們討論的，草稿已寄給法務。

example_en: I want to make sure we're on the same page.
example_zh: 我想確認我們的認知一致。

example_en: Sorry, there seems to be a misunderstanding.
example_zh: 抱歉，這裡好像有點誤會。

example_en: I apologize for the error in the invoice.
example_zh: 發票有誤，深感抱歉。

example_en: We regret to inform you that the item is out of stock.
example_zh: 很遺憾通知您，該商品已缺貨。

example_en: We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
example_zh: 造成不便，敬請見諒。

example_en: Sorry for any confusion; here is the correct file.
example_zh: 抱歉造成混淆，這是正確的檔案。

example_en: Due to an oversight, the file was not attached.
example_zh: 因為疏忽，檔案沒有附上。

example_en: The previous email was sent in error.
example_zh: 前一封信是誤寄的。

example_en: Please disregard my previous message.
example_zh: 請忽略我前一封訊息。

example_en: Sorry, there was a typo in the date.
example_zh: 抱歉，日期打錯了。

example_en: Apologies for the short notice, but can we meet today?
example_zh: 抱歉臨時通知，我們今天可以碰面嗎？

example_en: Thanks for reporting the outage. We are looking into it.
example_zh: 感謝通報斷線，我們正在調查處理。

example_en: We will rectify the billing error immediately.
example_zh: 我們會立刻更正帳單錯誤。

example_en: Thank you in advance for your help.
example_zh: 先謝謝您的協助。

example_en: Your quick reply is much appreciated.
example_zh: 非常感謝您迅速回覆。

example_en: Thank you for your patience while we fix the issue.
example_zh: 感謝您在我們處理問題期間耐心等候。

example_en: Thank you for your understanding during the maintenance.
example_zh: 維護期間感謝您的體諒。

example_en: Thank you for your cooperation with the survey.
example_zh: 感謝您配合填寫問卷。

example_en: Thank you for your time on the call today.
example_zh: 感謝您今天撥冗通話。

example_en: Thanks for the heads-up about the price change.
example_zh: 謝謝你事先告知價格調整。

example_en: Thanks for flagging this. I'll check with the team.
example_zh: 謝謝你提出來，我會跟團隊確認。

example_en: I truly appreciate your support on this project.
example_zh: 由衷感謝您對這個專案的支持。

example_en: Best regards, Amy Chen
example_zh: 敬祝順心，陳艾美
note: 最通用的商務結語

example_en: Kind regards, Kevin
example_zh: 謹致問候，Kevin

example_en: Sincerely, Lisa Wang, Sales Manager
example_zh: 業務經理 王麗莎 敬上
note: 較正式，常用於信函

zh: 溫馨問候（較親切的結語）
example_en: Warm regards, and see you next week.
example_zh: 溫馨問候，下週見。

example_en: Yours faithfully, Customer Service Team
example_zh: 客服團隊 謹啟
note: 英式；開頭用 Dear Sir/Madam 時搭配

en: Looking forward to hearing from you
example_en: Looking forward to hearing from you soon.
example_zh: 期待很快收到您的回音。

en: Looking forward to working with you
example_en: Looking forward to working with you on this project.
example_zh: 期待在這個專案與您合作。

en: Please do not hesitate to contact me
zh: 如有需要請隨時與我聯絡
ipa: /pliːz duː nɑːt ˈhezɪteɪt tə ˈkɑːntækt miː/
example_en: If you have questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.
example_zh: 如有任何問題，請隨時與我聯絡。

en: Let me know if you need anything else
ipa: /let miː noʊ ɪf juː niːd ˈeniθɪŋ els/
example_en: Let me know if you need anything else from me.
example_zh: 還需要我提供什麼請跟我說。

example_en: Thanks again, and have a great weekend!
example_zh: 再次感謝，祝週末愉快！

example_en: Thanks, Mike. Talk to you soon.
example_zh: 謝了 Mike，再聊。
note: 較口語，用於熟識同事

example_en: This is urgent. The customer is waiting.
example_zh: 這件事很緊急，客戶在等。

example_en: This request is time-sensitive, so please reply today.
example_zh: 這個需求有時效性，請今天回覆。

example_en: Fixing the outage is our top priority.
example_zh: 修復斷線是我們的最優先事項。

example_en: Please submit it no later than May 10.
example_zh: 請最遲在 5 月 10 日前提交。

example_en: I need it by Thursday at the latest.
example_zh: 我最晚週四要拿到。

example_en: Could you expedite the shipment?
example_zh: 可以加快出貨嗎？

example_en: Please send the report as soon as possible.
example_zh: 請儘快寄出報告。
note: ASAP 對客戶或長官用可能顯得命令

example_en: FYI, the client has changed the meeting room.
example_zh: 供參考，客戶換了會議室。

example_en: Please send your comments by EOD.
example_zh: 請在今天下班前給意見。

example_en: Payment must be received by COB Friday.
example_zh: 款項必須在週五營業結束前入帳。
note: 跨時區時最好註明是哪個時區

example_en: What's the ETA for the new router?
example_zh: 新路由器預計什麼時候到？
note: estimated time of arrival

example_en: The venue is still TBD.
example_zh: 場地還待定。

example_en: Start time: 9 a.m. (TBC)
example_zh: 開始時間：上午九點（待確認）

example_en: If a field doesn't apply, write N/A.
example_zh: 不適用的欄位請填 N/A。

example_en: RE: Quotation for fiber installation
example_zh: 回覆：光纖安裝報價

example_en: FW: Customer complaint from Osaka branch
example_zh: 轉寄：大阪分公司的客訴
note: 也寫作 FWD:

example_en: I'll be OOO from July 1 to 5.
example_zh: 我 7 月 1 日到 5 日不在辦公室。

example_en: BTW, the slides are in the shared folder.
example_zh: 順帶一提，簡報放在共用資料夾。
note: 只用於熟識同事

example_en: List the costs, e.g., travel and hotel.
example_zh: 列出費用，例如交通和住宿。
note: 拉丁文 exempli gratia

example_en: Send it by month-end, i.e., October 31.
example_zh: 請月底前寄出，也就是 10 月 31 日。
note: 和 e.g. 不同：i.e. 是換句話說

zh: 自某日起的那一週（week commencing）
example_en: Let's plan the training for w/c June 9.
example_zh: 訓練就排在 6 月 9 日那一週吧。

example_en: We agree. However, the budget is limited.
example_zh: 我們同意，不過預算有限。

example_en: The part is delayed; therefore, shipping will be late.
example_zh: 零件延遲，因此出貨會晚。

example_en: In addition, we offer free installation.
example_zh: 此外，我們提供免費安裝。

example_en: Furthermore, the new plan includes 5G.
example_zh: 而且，新方案包含 5G。

example_en: Prices have risen, and we have updated the quote accordingly.
example_zh: 價格上漲，我們已相應更新報價。

example_en: In the meantime, please use the backup line.
example_zh: 在此期間，請使用備援線路。

example_en: Alternatively, we can meet online.
example_zh: 或者，我們也可以線上開會。

example_en: In light of the typhoon, the visit is canceled.
example_zh: 鑑於颱風，此次拜訪取消。

example_en: With regard to your question, the answer is yes.
example_zh: 關於您的問題，答案是可以。

example_en: In response to your request, here are the logs.
example_zh: 回應您的需求，附上紀錄檔。

example_en: The aforementioned changes take effect next month.
example_zh: 前述變更將於下個月生效。
note: 非常正式，日常信件少用

example_en: Please be advised that our office will move in May.
example_zh: 特此通知，本公司辦公室將於五月搬遷。

example_en: Please note that prices exclude tax.
example_zh: 請注意，價格不含稅。

example_en: We are pleased to announce our new fiber service.
example_zh: 我們很高興宣布推出新的光纖服務。

example_en: Effective immediately, all orders need approval.
example_zh: 即日起，所有訂單都需要核准。

example_en: The service is suspended until further notice.
example_zh: 此服務暫停，直到另行通知。

example_en: Going forward, please cc me on all orders.
example_zh: 今後所有訂單請副本給我。

example_en: I'll circulate the minutes after the meeting.
example_zh: 會後我會把紀錄發給大家。

example_en: Our monthly newsletter goes out on the 1st.
example_zh: 我們的月刊電子報每月 1 號寄出。

example_en: HR sent an announcement about the new holiday.
example_zh: 人資寄了一封新假日的公告。

example_en: I'd like to introduce Mr. Sato, our new engineer.
example_zh: 我想介紹我們的新工程師佐藤先生。

example_en: I'm copying in my colleague, who handles billing.
example_zh: 我把負責帳務的同事加進副本。

example_en: Jenny will be your point of contact.
example_zh: Jenny 會是您的聯絡窗口。

example_en: Who is in charge of this account?
example_zh: 這個客戶是誰負責的？

example_en: I'll ask my counterpart in Japan.
example_zh: 我會問日本那邊的對口窗口。

example_en: Thanks, Tom. Moving you to bcc to spare your inbox.
example_zh: 謝謝 Tom，把你移到密件副本，省得你收一堆信。
note: 引介完雙方後的禮貌說法

example_en: The director needs to sign off on the plan.
example_zh: 這份計畫需要處長正式批准。

example_en: I'd welcome your input on the draft.
example_zh: 歡迎您對草稿提供意見。

example_en: I'll revise the proposal based on your comments.
example_zh: 我會依您的意見修改提案。

example_en: We hope to finalize the details this week.
example_zh: 我們希望本週把細節定案。

example_en: We're waiting for the client's go-ahead.
example_zh: 我們在等客戶點頭。

example_en: I'm afraid we must decline your offer.
example_zh: 恐怕我們必須婉拒您的提議。

example_en: I'm afraid I can't make it on Monday.
example_zh: 恐怕我週一沒辦法參加。

example_en: Please edit the contract with track changes on.
example_zh: 請開啟追蹤修訂來修改合約。

example_en: I'll have limited access to email next week.
example_zh: 我下週無法經常收信。

example_en: In my absence, please contact Mr. Lee.
example_zh: 我不在期間，請聯絡李先生。

example_en: I'll be back in the office on Tuesday.
example_zh: 我週二會回到辦公室。

example_en: I'm on annual leave until August 20.
example_zh: 我特休到 8 月 20 日。

example_en: Our Taiwan office is closed for a public holiday.
example_zh: 台灣辦公室因國定假日休息。

example_en: I'll respond to the customer by noon.
example_zh: 我中午前會答覆客戶。

example_en: Thank you for your inquiry about our plans.
example_zh: 感謝您洽詢我們的方案。

example_en: I sent a courtesy copy to your manager.
example_zh: 我寄了一份知會副本給你的主管。
note: 現代 cc 也常被解釋為 courtesy copy

example_en: Keep your emails short and concise.
example_zh: 信件請寫得簡短扼要。

example_en: I've listed the key issues in bullet points.
example_zh: 我把重點問題用條列方式寫出來。

example_en: Your action items are highlighted in yellow.
example_zh: 你的待辦事項用黃色標出來了。

example_en: I've highlighted the changes in red.
example_zh: 我已用紅色標示修改處。

zh: 直接寫在原文中的回覆
example_en: Please see my inline comments in blue below.
example_zh: 請看下方我用藍字直接回在原文中的意見。

example_en: This email is confidential. Please don't forward it.
example_zh: 這封信是機密，請勿轉寄。

example_en: Our email disclaimer is added automatically.
example_zh: 我們的郵件免責聲明是自動加上的。

example_en: If you are not the intended recipient, please delete this email.
example_zh: 若您非指定收件人，請刪除此信。
note: 常見於郵件免責聲明

example_en: Please reply by Wednesday noon.
example_zh: 請於週三中午前回覆。

en: Hope you had a great weekend
example_en: Hi Ken, hope you had a great weekend.
example_zh: Ken 你好，希望你週末過得愉快。

example_en: Thanks and regards, Peter Huang
example_zh: 謝謝，敬祝順心。黃彼得
